subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should WhatsApp reaction support be implemented as a complete read/event contract with generic `message reactions` queries and persistence, as a narrower plugin hook-only surface, or as live agent-visible system events without historical querying?
rationale: The issue is valid, but the implementation shape affects public action semantics, stored reaction data, hook payload privacy, access-control gating, and whether reactions become visible to agents, plugins, CLI queries, or all three.

options.title: Complete Read/Event Contract
options.body: Define one WhatsApp-owned contract covering generic reaction queries, historical or persisted reaction data, add/remove events, privacy gates, docs, and live proof.

options.title: Hook-Only First
options.body: Implement only privacy-gated `reaction_received` and `reaction_removed` plugin hooks first and leave generic CLI/action querying plus historical retrieval tracked separately.

options.title: Defer Broad Exposure
options.body: Keep WhatsApp reactions limited to outbound and approval-specific flows until maintainers are ready to expose reaction data more broadly.

recommendation.title: Complete Read/Event Contract
recommendation.body: Define one WhatsApp-owned contract covering generic reaction queries, historical or persisted reaction data, add/remove events, privacy gates, docs, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is closest to the existing WhatsApp hook/privacy contract surface, while still needing input from adjacent reaction/action owners.
